newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Pliva most active.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Pliva most active.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday with drugs concern Pliva dominating the trade and hoteliers posting new gains.
* Of 18 active issue eight rose, eight fell and two were flat.
* Volume rose to 20,234 units from 19,690, turnover fell to 9.6 million kuna from 10.3 million.
* Biggest gainer electrical concern Koncar added 260 kuna or 27.7 percent to 1,200 on volume of 80 shares.
* Biggest decliner shipper Atlantska Plovidba lost 30 kuna or 23.1 percent to 100 with 91 shares sold.
* Most active issue Pliva fell 4 kuna to 495 kuna, selling 7,828 shares.
